title.zh: 卷4下 世祖紀下 恭宗紀
title.en: Volume 4b Annals: Shizu 2 (Emperor Taiwu, Gongzong (Emperor Jingmu)
title.raw: 卷4下 世祖紀下 恭宗紀 Volume 4b Annals: Shizu 2 (Emperor Taiwu, Gongzong (Emperor Jingmu)

sentences.zh: 太平真君元年春正月己酉，沮渠無諱圍酒泉。

translations.literal: First year of Taiping Zhenjun, spring, first month, day jiyou: Juqu Wuhui besieged Jiuquan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taiping Zhenjun, on the jiyou day of the first month of spring, Juqu Wuhui besieged Jiuquan.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，分遣侍臣巡行州郡，觀察風俗，問民疾苦。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: attendants were dispatched separately to tour the provinces and commanderies, observe local customs, and inquire into the people's hardships.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day he sent courtiers through the provinces to observe customs and hear the people's grievances.

sentences.zh: 壬子，無諱誘執弋陽公元潔。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Wuhui lured and seized Prince of Yiyang Yuan Jie.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day Wuhui tricked and captured Yuan Jie, Prince of Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，詔假通直常侍邢穎使於劉義隆。

translations.literal: Second month, day jisi: an edict that Acting Palace Attendant of Unbroken Communication Xing Ying was to go as envoy to Liu Yilong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jisi day, he ordered Xing Ying, Acting Palace Attendant of Unbroken Communication, as envoy to Liu Yilong.

sentences.zh: 發長安五千人浚昆明池。

translations.literal: Five thousand men were levied from Chang'an to dredge Kunming Pool.
translations.idiomatic: Five thousand men were sent from Chang'an to dredge Kunming Pool.

sentences.zh: 三月，酒泉陷。

translations.literal: Third month: Jiuquan fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Jiuquan was taken.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰，無諱寇張掖，禿髮保周屯于刪丹。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengchen: Wuhui raided Zhangye; Tufa Baozhou encamped at Shandan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the gengchen day, Wuhui attacked Zhangye while Tufa Baozhou camped at Shandan.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔撫軍大將軍、永昌王健等督諸軍討保周。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: an edict that General Who Pacifies the Army, Prince of Yongchang Jian and others were to command the armies against Baozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day he ordered Jian, Prince of Yongchang, General Who Pacifies the Army, and others to lead the armies against Baozhou.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯，行幸北部。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinmao: the imperial carriage traveled to the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the fifth month the emperor went to the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，無諱復圍張掖，不克，退還。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Wuhui again besieged Zhangye but could not take it and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day Wuhui again besieged Zhangye, failed, and retreated.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，皇孫濬生，大赦，改年。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingchou: the imperial grandson Jun was born; a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the sixth month the imperial grandson Jun was born; there was a general amnesty and a new reign title.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，行幸陰山。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: the imperial carriage traveled to Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn the emperor went to Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 己丑，永昌王健至番禾，破保周，保周遁走。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Prince of Yongchang Jian reached Fanhe, defeated Baozhou, and Baozhou fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day Jian, Prince of Yongchang, reached Fanhe, broke Baozhou, and Baozhou fled.

sentences.zh: 丙申，皇太后竇氏崩于行宮。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: the Empress Dowager, Lady Dou, died at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day the Empress Dowager, Lady Dou, died at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，保周自殺，傳首京師。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Baozhou killed himself; his head was sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day Baozhou took his own life and his head was sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 八月甲申，無諱降，送弋陽公元潔及諸將士。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiashen: Wuhui surrendered and sent Yuan Jie, Prince of Yiyang, and the generals and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiashen day, Wuhui surrendered and delivered Yuan Jie, Prince of Yiyang, with the officers and troops.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renyin: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the renyin day, the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 冬十有一月丁亥，行幸山北。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day dinghai: the imperial carriage traveled to the north of the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the dinghai day, the emperor went north of the mountains.

sentences.zh: 十二月，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 是歲，州鎮十五民飢，開倉賑恤。

translations.literal: That year fifteen provinces and garrisons suffered famine; granaries were opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That year fifteen provinces and garrisons knew famine; the storehouses were opened for relief.

sentences.zh: 以河南王曜子羯兒為河間王，後改封略陽王。

translations.literal: Jie'er, son of Prince of Henan Yao, was made Prince of Hejian, later re-enfeoffed as Prince of Lueyang.
translations.idiomatic: Jie'er, son of Yao, Prince of Henan, was made Prince of Hejian and later Prince of Lueyang.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月癸卯，拜沮渠無諱為征西大將軍、涼州牧、酒泉王。

translations.literal: Year 2, spring, first month, day guimao: Juqu Wuhui was appointed General Who Conquers the West, Governor of Liangzhou, and King of Jiuquan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the guimao day of the first month of spring, Juqu Wuhui was made General Who Conquers the West, Governor of Liangzhou, and King of Jiuquan.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，行幸溫泉。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: the imperial carriage traveled to the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day the emperor went to the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Second month, day renxu: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the renxu day, the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，葬惠太后於崞山。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinmao: Empress Dowager Hui was buried at Mount Guo.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinmao day, Empress Dowager Hui was buried at Mount Guo.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，新興王俊、略陽王羯兒有罪，並黜為公。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Prince of Xinxing Jun and Prince of Lueyang Jie'er were guilty and both demoted to duke.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Jun, Prince of Xinxing, and Jie'er, Prince of Lueyang, were found guilty and both reduced to duke.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，封蠕蠕郁久閭乞列歸為朔方王，沮渠萬年為張掖王。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Yujiulü Qieliegui of the Rouran was enfeoffed as King of Shuofang, and Juqu Wannian as King of Zhangye.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day Yujiulü Qieliegui of the Rouran was made King of Shuofang and Juqu Wannian King of Zhangye.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，劉義隆遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingsi: Liu Yilong sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the dingsi day, Liu Yilong sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔鎮南將軍、南陽公奚眷征酒泉。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: an edict that General Who Guards the South, Duke of Nanyang Xi Juan, was to campaign against Jiuquan.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day he ordered Xi Juan, Duke of Nanyang, General Who Guards the South, against Jiuquan.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯，行幸山北。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinmao: the imperial carriage traveled to the north of the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the fifth month the emperor went north of the mountains.

sentences.zh: 秋八月辛亥，詔散騎侍郎張偉等使劉義隆。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day xinhai: an edict that Palace Attendant Zhang Wei and others were to go as envoys to Liu Yilong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the xinhai day, he ordered Zhang Wei, Palace Attendant, and others as envoys to Liu Yilong.

sentences.zh: 行幸河西。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage traveled to Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor went to Hexi.

sentences.zh: 九月戊戌，撫軍大將軍、永昌王健薨。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuxu: Prince of Yongchang Jian died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the wuxu day, Jian, Prince of Yongchang, died.

sentences.zh: 冬十有一月庚子，鎮南將軍奚眷平酒泉，獲沮渠天周、臧嗟、屈德，男女四千口。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day gengzi: General Who Guards the South Xi Juan pacified Jiuquan, capturing Juqu Tianzhou, Zang Jie, and Qu De, with four thousand men and women.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the gengzi day, Xi Juan pacified Jiuquan and took Juqu Tianzhou, Zang Jie, and Qu De, with four thousand captives.

sentences.zh: 十有二月甲戌，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiaxu: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jiaxu day, the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙午，劉義隆遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Liu Yilong sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day Liu Yilong sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月甲申，帝至道壇，親受符籙，備法駕，旗幟盡青。

translations.literal: Year 3, spring, first month, day jiashen: the Emperor came to the Dao altar, received talismans in person, and used the full regalia; banners and flags were all green.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the jiashen day of the first month of spring, the Emperor came to the Dao altar, received talismans in person, and used full regalia with green banners and flags.

sentences.zh: 語在釋老志。

translations.literal: The account is in the treatise on Buddhism and Daoism.
translations.idiomatic: The account is in the treatise on Buddhism and Daoism.

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅，北平王長孫頹有罪，削爵為侯。

translations.literal: Third month, day renyin: Prince of Beiping Changsun Tui was guilty and his noble rank was reduced to marquis.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the renyin day, Tui, Prince of Beiping, was found guilty and reduced to marquis.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，無諱走渡流沙，據鄯善。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: Wuhui fled across the shifting sands and held Shanshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Wuhui fled across the shifting sands and seized Shanshan.

sentences.zh: 李暠孫寶據敦煌，遣使內附。

translations.literal: Li Bao's grandson Bao held Dunhuang and sent envoys to submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: Bao, grandson of Li Gao, held Dunhuang and sent envoys to submit.

sentences.zh: 五月，[1]行幸陰山之北。

translations.literal: Fifth month, [1] the imperial carriage traveled to the north of Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, [1] the emperor went north of Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 閏月，劉義隆龍驤將軍裴方明、梁州刺史劉康祖寇南秦，南秦王楊難當敗，奔於上邽。

translations.literal: Intercalary month: Liu Yilong's General of Dragon Agility Pei Fangming and Inspector of Liangzhou Liu Kangzu invaded Southern Qin; the Southern Qin king Yang Dandang was defeated and fled to Shanggui.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month Pei Fangming, Liu Yilong's General of Dragon Agility, and Liu Kangzu, Inspector of Liangzhou, invaded Southern Qin; Yang Dandang, king of Southern Qin, was beaten and fled to Shanggui.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌，難當朝於行宮。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingxu: Dandang attended court at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the sixth month Dandang came to court at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 先是，起殿於陰山之北，殿始成而難當至，因名曰廣德焉。

translations.literal: Earlier a hall had been raised north of Yinshan; when the hall was just completed Dandang arrived, and it was therefore named Broad Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: A hall had already been built north of Yinshan; when it was finished Dandang arrived, and the hall was named Broad Virtue.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙寅，詔安西將軍、建興公古弼督隴右諸軍及殿中虎賁與武都王楊保宗等從祁山南入，征西將軍、淮陽公皮豹子與琅邪王司馬楚之等督關中諸軍從散關西入，俱會仇池；

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingyin: an edict that General Who Pacifies the West, Duke of Jianxing Gu Bi, was to command the armies of Longyou and the palace tiger guards, and with Prince of Wudu Yang Baozong and others enter south from Qishan; General Who Conquers the West, Duke of Huaiyang Pi Baozi, with Prince of Langye Sima Chuzhi and others were to command the armies of Guanzhong and enter west from Sanguan—all to meet at Chouchi;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the bingyin day, he ordered Gu Bi, Duke of Jianxing, General Who Pacifies the West, with the Longyou armies and palace guards and Yang Baozong, Prince of Wudu, south from Qishan; Pi Baozi, Duke of Huaiyang, General Who Conquers the West, with Sima Chuzhi, Prince of Langye, and the Guanzhong armies west from Sanguan—all to join at Chouchi;

sentences.zh: 鬱林公司馬文思為征南大將軍，進爵譙王，督洛豫諸軍事南趣襄陽；

translations.literal: Duke of Yulin Sima Wensi was made General Who Conquers the South, advanced to Prince of Qiao, and commanded the military affairs of Luo and Yu, marching south toward Xiangyang;
translations.idiomatic: Sima Wensi, Duke of Yulin, was made General Who Conquers the South, advanced to Prince of Qiao, and commanded Luo and Yu, marching south on Xiangyang;

sentences.zh: 征南將軍東安公刁雍東趣廣陵，邀方明歸路。

translations.literal: General Who Conquers the South, Duke of Dong'an Diao Yong, marched east toward Guangling to cut off Fangming's line of retreat.
translations.idiomatic: Diao Yong, Duke of Dong'an, General Who Conquers the South, marched east on Guangling to block Fangming's retreat.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月己巳，征西將軍皮豹子等大破劉義隆將於樂鄉，擒其將王奐之、王長卿等，強玄明、辛伯奮棄下辨遁走，追斬之，盡虜其眾。

translations.literal: Year 4, spring, first month, day jisi: General Who Conquers the West Pi Baozi and others greatly defeated Liu Yilong's generals at Lexiang, capturing the generals Wang Huanzhi and Wang Changqing; Qiang Xuanming and Xin Bofen abandoned Xiabian and fled, were pursued and beheaded, and all their troops were captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the jisi day of the first month of spring, Pi Baozi and the western army routed Liu Yilong's generals at Lexiang, taking Wang Huanzhi and Wang Changqing; Qiang Xuanming and Xin Bofen fled from Xiabian, were run down and killed, and their forces were wholly captured.

sentences.zh: 庚午，行幸中山。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the imperial carriage traveled to Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day the emperor went to Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 二月丙子，車駕至于恒山之陽，詔有司刊石勒銘。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingzi: the imperial carriage reached the south of Mount Heng; an edict ordered the officials to carve stone and inscribe a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the bingzi day, the court reached the south of Mount Heng and ordered stone carved with an inscription.

sentences.zh: 是月，克仇池。

translations.literal: That month Chouchi was taken.
translations.idiomatic: That month Chouchi fell.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengshen: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengshen day, the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，烏洛侯國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Day renxu: the state of Wuluohou sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day the state of Wuluohou sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，武都王楊保宗謀反，諸將擒送京師；

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: Prince of Wudu Yang Baozong plotted rebellion; the generals seized him and sent him to the capital;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Yang Baozong, Prince of Wudu, plotted rebellion; the generals seized him and sent him to the capital;

sentences.zh: 諸氐、羌復推保宗弟文德為主，圍仇池。

translations.literal: the Di and Qiang again set up Baozong's younger brother Wendé as leader and besieged Chouchi.
translations.idiomatic: the Di and Qiang again made Wendé, Baozong's younger brother, their leader and besieged Chouchi.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day there was a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 己亥，行幸陰山。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the imperial carriage traveled to Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day the emperor went to Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 五月，將軍古弼大破諸氐，解仇池圍。

translations.literal: Fifth month: General Gu Bi greatly defeated the various Di and lifted the siege of Chouchi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Gu Bi routed the Di and raised the siege of Chouchi.

sentences.zh: 六月庚寅，詔曰：「朕承天子民，憂理萬國，欲令百姓家給人足，興於禮義。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengyin: an edict said: "We have received Heaven's charge over the people and worry over governing the myriad states, wishing to make every household ample and every person provided for, and to raise ritual and righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the sixth month an edict declared: "We have received Heaven's charge and worry over the myriad realms, wishing every household full and every person provided for, and to raise ritual and righteousness.

sentences.zh: 而牧守令宰不能助朕宣揚恩德，勤恤民隱，至乃侵奪其產，加以殘虐，非所以為治也。

translations.literal: Yet governors, defenders, magistrates, and chiefs cannot help Us spread favor and virtue or diligently tend the people's hardships—indeed they seize and plunder their goods and add cruelty on top; this is not how to govern.
translations.idiomatic: Yet governors and magistrates do not help Us spread grace or tend the people's hardships; they seize their goods and add cruelty—this is not governance.

sentences.zh: 今復民貲賦三年，其田租歲輸如常。

translations.literal: Now We again remit the people's property levies for three years; field tax shall be delivered yearly as usual.
translations.idiomatic: We now remit property levies for three years; field tax shall still be paid yearly as usual.

sentences.zh: 牧守之徒，各厲精為治，勸課農桑，不聽妄有徵發，有司彈糾，勿有所縱。

translations.literal: As for governors and the like, each must exert himself in governance, encourage farming and sericulture, and must not rashly issue levies; the responsible offices shall impeach and not indulge.
translations.idiomatic: Governors must govern diligently, encourage farming, and issue no rash levies; the offices shall impeach and not indulge.

sentences.zh: 」癸巳，大閱于西郊。

translations.literal: " On guisi a great review was held at the western suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi a great review was held at the western suburb.

sentences.zh: 秋九月辛丑，行幸漠南。

translations.literal: Autumn, ninth month, day xinchou: the imperial carriage traveled to the southern desert.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn, on the xinchou day, the emperor went to the southern desert.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，捨輜重，以輕騎襲蠕蠕，分軍為四道。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: baggage was left behind and light horse struck the Rouran; the army was divided into four routes.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day baggage was left behind and light horse struck the Rouran in four columns.

sentences.zh: 事具蠕蠕傳。

translations.literal: The account is fully set forth in the Rouran treatise.
translations.idiomatic: The full account is in the treatise on the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 鎮北將軍封沓亡入蠕蠕。

translations.literal: General Who Guards the North Feng Da fled into the Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Da, General Who Guards the North, fled to the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，將軍皮豹子等追破劉義隆將於濁水。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month: General Pi Baozi and others pursued and defeated Liu Yilong's generals at Zhuoshui.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter Pi Baozi and others pursued and defeated Liu Yilong's generals at Zhuoshui.

sentences.zh: 甲子，車駕至於朔方。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: the imperial carriage reached Shuofang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day the court reached Shuofang.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕承祖宗重光之緒，思闡洪基，恢隆萬世。

translations.literal: An edict said: "We have received the doubled radiance of Our ancestors' enterprise and think to expand the great foundation and elevate it for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "We have received the doubled glory of Our ancestors' foundation and mean to enlarge the great base for ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 自經營天下，平暴除亂，掃清不順，二十年矣。

translations.literal: From the time We undertook the realm, pacifying violence and removing disorder and sweeping away the disobedient, twenty years have passed.
translations.idiomatic: Since We undertook the realm, pacifying violence and clearing the disobedient, twenty years have passed.

sentences.zh: 夫陰陽有往復，四時有代謝。

translations.literal: Yin and yang have their return; the four seasons have their succession.
translations.idiomatic: Yin and yang turn back; the four seasons succeed one another.

sentences.zh: 授子任賢，所以休息，優隆功臣，式圖長久，蓋古今不易之令典也。

translations.literal: Entrusting the son and employing the worthy are how one rests; honoring meritorious ministers and planning for long duration—such are the unchanging statutes of antiquity and the present alike.
translations.idiomatic: To entrust the heir and employ the worthy is to rest; to honor meritorious ministers and plan long duration is the unchanging law of antiquity and today alike.

sentences.zh: 其令皇太子副理萬機，總統百揆。

translations.literal: Let the Crown Prince assist in governing the myriad affairs and oversee all departments.
translations.idiomatic: Let the Crown Prince assist in the myriad affairs and oversee all departments.

sentences.zh: 諸朕功臣，勤勞日久，皆當以爵歸第，隨時朝請，饗宴朕前，論道陳謨而已，不宜復煩以劇職。

translations.literal: All Our meritorious ministers, long in toil, shall each return their noble ranks to their estates, attend court when summoned, feast before Us, and discuss the Way and present counsel only—they should not again be burdened with arduous offices.
translations.idiomatic: Our long-serving ministers shall each return to their estates, attend when summoned, feast before Us, and counsel only—they should not again bear heavy office.

sentences.zh: 更舉賢俊，以備百官。

translations.literal: Select worthy and outstanding men anew to fill the hundred offices.
translations.idiomatic: Select worthy men anew for the hundred offices.

sentences.zh: 主者明為科制，以稱朕心。

translations.literal: The responsible offices shall clearly set regulations to match Our mind."
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices shall set regulations to match Our mind."

sentences.zh: 」十二月辛卯，車駕至自北伐。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinmao: the imperial carriage returned from the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the xinmao day, the court returned from the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月壬寅，皇太子始總百揆。

translations.literal: Year 5, spring, first month, day renyin: the Crown Prince first oversaw all departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the renyin day of the first month of spring, the Crown Prince first oversaw all departments.

sentences.zh: 侍中、中書監、宜都王穆壽，司徒、東郡公崔浩，侍中、廣平公張黎，侍中、建興公古弼，輔太子以決庶政。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant, Director of the Secretariat, Prince of Yidu Mu Shou; Chancellor of State, Duke of Dongjun Cui Hao; Palace Attendant, Duke of Guangping Zhang Li; Palace Attendant, Duke of Jianxing Gu Bi—all assisted the Crown Prince in deciding ordinary government.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Shou, Prince of Yidu, Palace Attendant and Director of the Secretariat; Cui Hao, Duke of Dongjun, Chancellor of State; Zhang Li, Duke of Guangping, Palace Attendant; and Gu Bi, Duke of Jianxing, Palace Attendant—all assisted the Crown Prince in daily government.

sentences.zh: 諸上書者皆稱臣，上疏儀與表同。

translations.literal: All who submitted memorials addressed themselves as subjects; the ritual for memorials was the same as for formal tables.
translations.idiomatic: All who submitted memorials styled themselves subjects; memorial ritual matched that of formal tables.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔曰：「愚民無識，信惑妖邪，私養師巫，挾藏讖記、陰陽、圖緯、方伎之書；

translations.literal: Day wushen: an edict said: "The foolish people lack understanding, trust and are deluded by demonic heterodoxy, privately keep masters and shamans, and conceal prognostic texts, yin-yang charts, weft books, and occult arts;
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day an edict declared: "The foolish lack understanding, trust demonic heterodoxy, keep shamans privately, and hide prognostic texts, yin-yang charts, weft books, and occult arts;

sentences.zh: 又沙門之徒，假西戎虛誕，生致妖孽。

translations.literal: and the Buddhist monks, borrowing the empty fictions of the western barbarians, give rise to demonic harm.
translations.idiomatic: and Buddhist monks, borrowing western fictions, breed demonic harm.

sentences.zh: 非所以壹齊政化，布淳德於天下也。

translations.literal: This is not how to unify government and teaching or spread pure virtue through the realm.
translations.idiomatic: This does not unify government and teaching or spread pure virtue through the realm.

sentences.zh: 自王公已下至於庶人，有私養沙門、師巫及金銀工巧之人在其家者，皆遣詣官曹，不得容匿。

translations.literal: From princes and dukes down to commoners, whoever privately keeps Buddhist monks, shamans, or workers in gold, silver, and craft in his household shall send them to the government offices and may not harbor them.
translations.idiomatic: From princes down to commoners, whoever privately keeps monks, shamans, or gold and silver craftsmen must send them to the offices and may not hide them.

sentences.zh: 限今年二月十五日，過期不出，師巫、沙門身死，主人門誅。

translations.literal: The limit is the fifteenth day of the second month this year; after that deadline, if they do not come forth, the shaman or monk dies and the householder's clan is executed.
translations.idiomatic: The deadline is the fifteenth day of the second month this year; after it, shamans and monks die and the householder's clan is executed.

sentences.zh: 明相宣告，咸使聞知。

translations.literal: Proclaim this clearly so all may hear and know."
translations.idiomatic: Proclaim this clearly so all may know."

sentences.zh: 」庚戌，詔曰：「自頃以來，軍國多事，未宣文教，非所以整齊風俗，示軌則於天下也。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: an edict said: "In recent times military and state affairs have been many and civil teaching has not been proclaimed—this is not how to order customs and show the model to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day an edict declared: "Lately military affairs have crowded out civil teaching—this does not order customs or show the model to the realm.

sentences.zh: 今制自王公已下至於卿士，其子息皆詣太學。

translations.literal: Now it is decreed that from princes and dukes down to ministers and grandees, their sons shall all attend the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Now from princes down to ministers, all sons shall attend the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 其百工伎巧、騶卒子息，當習其父兄所業，不聽私立學校。

translations.literal: Sons of artisans, craftsmen, stable grooms, and runners shall practice their fathers' and elder brothers' trades and may not privately establish schools.
translations.idiomatic: Sons of artisans, grooms, and runners shall learn their fathers' trades and may not set up private schools.

sentences.zh: 違者師身死，主人門誅。」

translations.literal: Violators: the teacher dies and the householder's clan is executed."
translations.idiomatic: Violators: the teacher dies and the householder's clan is executed."

sentences.zh: 二月辛未，中山王辰等八將，以北伐後期，斬于都南。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinwei: Prince of Zhongshan Chen and eight other generals, for being late after the northern campaign, were beheaded south of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinwei day, Chen, Prince of Zhongshan, and eight other generals were beheaded south of the capital for lateness after the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，驃騎大將軍、樂平王丕薨。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: General of Agile Cavalry, Prince of Leiping Pi, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day Pi, Prince of Leiping, General of Agile Cavalry, died.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，行幸廬

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the imperial carriage traveled to Lu
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day the imperial carriage traveled to Lu

translations.literal: The text is deficient.
translations.idiomatic: The text is deficient.

sentences.zh: [2]三月戊戌，大會于那南池。

translations.literal: [2] Third month, day wuxu: a great assembly was held at the southern pool of Na.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the wuxu day, [2] a great assembly was held at the southern pool of Na.

sentences.zh: 遣使者四輩使西域。

translations.literal: Envoys of four missions were sent to the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys of four missions were sent to the Western Regions.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔征西大將軍、司空、上黨王長孫道生鎮統萬。

translations.literal: Day guichou: an edict that General Who Conquers the West, Minister of Works, Prince of Shangdang Changsun Daosheng was to garrison Tongwan.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day he ordered Changsun Daosheng, Prince of Shangdang, General Who Conquers the West and Minister of Works, to garrison Tongwan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙亥，侍中、太宰、陽平王杜超為帳下所殺。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yihai: Palace Attendant, Grand Preceptor, Prince of Yangping Du Chao was killed by his attendants.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the yihai day, Du Chao, Prince of Yangping, Palace Attendant and Grand Preceptor, was killed by his attendants.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉，行幸陰山之北。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingyou: the imperial carriage traveled to the north of Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the fifth month the emperor went north of Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 六月，北部民殺立義將軍、衡陽公莫孤，率五千餘落北走。

translations.literal: Sixth month: northern tribesmen killed General Who Establishes Righteousness, Duke of Hengyang Mo Gu, and led more than five thousand households north in flight.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month northern tribesmen killed Mo Gu, Duke of Hengyang, General Who Establishes Righteousness, and led more than five thousand households north.

sentences.zh: 追擊于漠南，殺其渠帥，餘徙居冀、相、定三州為營戶。

translations.literal: They were pursued in the southern desert; their chieftains were killed and the remainder were moved to Ji, Xiang, and Ding provinces as camp households.
translations.idiomatic: Pursued in the southern desert, their chiefs were killed and the rest were settled in Ji, Xiang, and Ding as camp households.

sentences.zh: 西平王吐谷渾慕利延殺其兄子緯代。

translations.literal: Prince of Xiping Tuyuhun Muli Yan killed his nephew Weidai.
translations.idiomatic: Muli Yan, Prince of Xiping of the Tuyuhun, killed his nephew Weidai.

sentences.zh: 是月，緯代弟叱力延等來奔，乞師。

translations.literal: That month Weidai's younger brother Chiliyan and others came in flight and begged troops.
translations.idiomatic: That month Chiliyan, Weidai's younger brother, and others fled in and begged for troops.

sentences.zh: 以叱力延為歸義王。

translations.literal: Chiliyan was made Prince Who Returns to Righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Chiliyan was made Prince Who Returns to Righteousness.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸卯，東雍州刺史沮渠秉謀叛伏誅。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guimao: Juqu Bing, Inspector of Eastern Yongzhou, plotted rebellion and was executed in secret.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the guimao day, Juqu Bing, Inspector of Eastern Yongzhou, plotted rebellion and was secretly executed.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑，田于河西。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yichou: a hunt was held in Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the yichou day, a hunt was held in Hexi.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔員外散騎常侍高濟使於劉義隆。

translations.literal: Day renwu: an edict that Supernumerary Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Gao Ji was to go as envoy to Liu Yilong.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day he ordered Gao Ji, Supernumerary Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry, as envoy to Liu Yilong.

sentences.zh: 晉王伏羅督高平、涼州諸軍討吐谷渾慕利延。

translations.literal: Prince of Jin Fulu commanded the armies of Gaoping and Liangzhou against Tuyuhun Muli Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Fulu, Prince of Jin, commanded the armies of Gaoping and Liangzhou against Muli Yan of the Tuyuhun.

sentences.zh: 九月，帝自河西至馬邑，觀于崞川。

translations.literal: Ninth month: the Emperor came from Hexi to Mayi and reviewed troops at Guochuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Emperor came from Hexi to Mayi and reviewed troops at Guochuan.

sentences.zh: 己亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁未，行幸漠南。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the imperial carriage traveled to the southern desert.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day the emperor went to the southern desert.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸未，晉王伏羅大破慕利延，慕利延走奔白蘭。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guiwei: Prince of Jin Fulu greatly defeated Muli Yan; Muli Yan fled to Bailan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the guiwei day, Fulu routed Muli Yan, who fled to Bailan.

sentences.zh: 慕利延從弟伏念、長史鵴鳩梨、部大崇娥等率其部一萬三千落內附。

translations.literal: Muli Yan's younger cousin Funian, Chief Clerk Hejiuli, and the great chieftain E led more than thirteen thousand households of their tribe to submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: Funian, Muli Yan's younger cousin, Chief Clerk Hejiuli, and the great chieftain E led more than thirteen thousand households to submit.

sentences.zh: 十一月，劉義隆遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: Liu Yilong sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Liu Yilong sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月，粟特國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: the state of Sute sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the state of Sute sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月辛亥，車駕行幸定州，引見長老，存問之。

translations.literal: Year 6, spring, first month, day xinhai: the imperial carriage traveled to Dingzhou, summoned the elders, and inquired after them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on the xinhai day of the first month of spring, the emperor went to Dingzhou, summoned the elders, and inquired after them.

sentences.zh: 詔兼員外散騎常侍宋愔使劉義隆。

translations.literal: An edict that Concurrent Supernumerary Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Song Yin was to go as envoy to Liu Yilong.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Song Yin, Concurrent Supernumerary Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry, as envoy to Liu Yilong.

sentences.zh: 二月，遂西幸上黨，觀連理樹於泫氏。

translations.literal: Second month: he then traveled west to Shangdang and viewed an intertwined tree at Xuanshi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he went west to Shangdang and viewed an intertwined tree at Xuanshi.

sentences.zh: 西至吐京，討徙叛胡，出配郡縣。

translations.literal: West to Tujing: rebellious Hu who had been moved were punished and assigned out to commanderies and districts.
translations.idiomatic: West to Tujing: moved rebels were punished and assigned to commanderies and districts.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengshen: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengshen day, the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 詔諸有疑獄皆付中書，以經義量決。

translations.literal: An edict that all doubtful criminal cases were to be sent to the Secretariat and decided by canonical principle.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered that all doubtful criminal cases go to the Secretariat and be decided by canonical principle.

sentences.zh: 是月，酒泉公郝溫反於杏城，殺守將王幡。

translations.literal: That month Duke of Jiuquan Hao Wen rebelled at Xingcheng and killed the defending general Wang Fan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hao Wen, Duke of Jiuquan, rebelled at Xingcheng and killed the garrison commander Wang Fan.

sentences.zh: 縣吏蓋鮮率宗族討溫，溫棄城走，自殺，家屬伏誅。

translations.literal: District clerk Gai Xian led his clan to attack Wen; Wen abandoned the city and fled, killed himself, and his household was executed.
translations.idiomatic: District clerk Gai Xian led his clan against Wen; Wen fled, killed himself, and his household was executed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌，征西大將軍、高涼王那等討吐谷渾慕利延於陰平白蘭。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengxu: General Who Conquers the West, Prince of Gaoliang Na and others campaigned against Tuyuhun Muli Yan at Yinping Bailan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the gengxu day, Na, Prince of Gaoliang, General Who Conquers the West, and others campaigned against Muli Yan at Yinping Bailan.

sentences.zh: 詔秦州刺史、天水公封敕文擊慕利延兄子什歸於枹罕，散騎常侍、成周公萬度歸乘傳發涼州以西兵襲鄯善。

translations.literal: An edict that Inspector of Qinzhou, Duke of Tianshui Feng Jiwen, was to strike Muli Yan's nephew Shigui at Fuhan, and Palace Attendant, Duke of Chenggong Wandu Gui was to rush troops west from Liangzhou to raid Shanshan.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Feng Jiwen, Duke of Tianshui, Inspector of Qinzhou, against Shigui at Fuhan, and Wandu Gui, Duke of Chenggong, Palace Attendant, to rush troops from Liangzhou west against Shanshan.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，車駕北巡。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renchen: the imperial carriage toured north.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the sixth month the emperor toured north.

sentences.zh: 什歸聞軍將至，棄城夜遁。

translations.literal: Shigui, hearing the army was coming, abandoned the city and fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing the army was coming, Shigui abandoned the city and fled by night.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丁亥，封敕文入枹罕，分徙千家還上邽。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day dinghai: Feng Jiwen entered Fuhan and moved a thousand households back to Shanggui.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the dinghai day, Feng Jiwen entered Fuhan and moved a thousand households back to Shanggui.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，度歸以輕騎至鄯善，執其王真達以詣京師，帝大悅，厚待之。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Wandu Gui with light horse reached Shanshan, seized its king Zhenda, and sent him to the capital; the Emperor was greatly pleased and treated him generously.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day Wandu Gui reached Shanshan with light horse, seized King Zhenda, and sent him to the capital; the Emperor was greatly pleased and treated him generously.

sentences.zh: 車駕幸陰山之北，次于廣德宮。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage traveled to the north of Yinshan and halted at the Broad Virtue Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor went north of Yinshan and halted at Broad Virtue Palace.

sentences.zh: 詔發天下兵，三分取一，各當戒嚴，以須後命。

translations.literal: An edict mobilized troops throughout the realm, one man in three, each to stand in readiness awaiting further orders.
translations.idiomatic: He mobilized troops throughout the realm, one man in three, each to stand ready for orders.

sentences.zh: 徙諸種雜人五千餘家於北邊。

translations.literal: More than five thousand households of various mixed peoples were moved to the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: More than five thousand households of mixed peoples were moved to the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 令民北徙畜牧至廣漠，以餌蠕蠕。

translations.literal: The people were ordered to move north to pasture livestock as far as the broad desert, to bait the Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: The people were ordered north to pasture as far as the broad desert to bait the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，高涼王那軍到曼頭城，慕利延驅其部落西渡流沙，那急追。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Prince of Gaoliang Na's army reached Mantoucheng; Muli Yan drove his tribes west across the shifting sands and Na pursued urgently.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day Na's army reached Mantoucheng; Muli Yan drove his tribes west across the sands and Na pursued hard.

sentences.zh: 故西秦王慕璝世子被囊逆軍拒戰，那擊破之，被囊輕騎遁走，中山公杜豐精騎追之，度三危，至雪山，生擒被囊、什歸及熾磐子成龍，送于京師。

translations.literal: The former Western Qin king Murong Kui's heir prince Beinang resisted the army in battle; Na defeated him; Beinang fled with light horse; Duke of Zhongshan Du Feng with picked horse pursued across Sanwei to Snow Mountain, captured Beinang and Shigui alive, and Qifu Chipan's son Chenglong, and sent them to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Beinang, heir of the former Western Qin king Murong Kui, resisted; Na defeated him; Beinang fled; Du Feng, Duke of Zhongshan, pursued with picked horse across Sanwei to Snow Mountain and took Beinang, Shigui, and Chenglong, son of Qifu Chipan, alive to the capital.

sentences.zh: 慕利延遂西入于闐國。

translations.literal: Muli Yan then went west into the state of Khotan.
translations.idiomatic: Muli Yan then went west into Khotan.

sentences.zh: 九月，盧水胡蓋吳聚眾反於杏城。

translations.literal: Ninth month: the Lushui Hu Gai Wu gathered a host and rebelled at Xingcheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Gai Wu of the Lushui Hu gathered a host and rebelled at Xingcheng.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊子，長安鎮副將元紇率眾討之，為吳所殺。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuzi: Deputy garrison commander of Chang'an Yuan He led troops against him and was killed by Wu.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the wuzi day, Yuan He, deputy commander of Chang'an, led troops against him and was killed by Wu.

sentences.zh: 吳黨遂盛，民皆渡渭奔南山。

translations.literal: Wu's party then flourished; the people all crossed the Wei and fled to the southern mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Wu's party then grew strong; the people crossed the Wei and fled to the southern mountains.

sentences.zh: 於是詔發高平敕勒騎赴長安，詔將軍叔孫拔乘傳領攝并、秦、雍兵屯渭北。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict mobilized Gaoping Tiele horse for Chang'an, and ordered General Shusun Ba by rapid relay to take command of Bing, Qin, and Yong troops and encamp north of the Wei.
translations.idiomatic: He mobilized Gaoping Tiele horse for Chang'an and ordered Shusun Ba by rapid relay to command Bing, Qin, and Yong troops north of the Wei.

sentences.zh: 十有一月，高涼王那振旅還京師。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: Prince of Gaoliang Na led the army back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Na led the army back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 己未，遣那及殿中尚書安定公韓茂率騎屯相州之陽平郡，發冀州民造浮橋於碻磝津。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Na and Palace Attendant, Duke of Anding Han Mao were sent with horse to encamp in Yangping commandery of Xiangzhou; people of Jizhou were levied to build a pontoon bridge at Que'ao Ford.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day Na and Han Mao, Duke of Anding, Palace Attendant, were sent with horse to Yangping in Xiangzhou; people of Jizhou built a pontoon at Que'ao Ford.

sentences.zh: 蓋吳遣其部落帥白廣平西掠新平，安定諸夷酋皆聚眾應之，殺汧城守將。

translations.literal: Gai Wu sent his tribal chief Bai Guangping west to raid Xinping; chieftains of the various Yi of Anding all gathered hosts in response and killed the garrison commander of Qian city.
translations.idiomatic: Gai Wu sent Bai Guangping west to raid Xinping; Anding chieftains rose in response and killed the commander of Qian city.

sentences.zh: 吳遂進軍李閏堡，分兵掠臨晉巴東。

translations.literal: Wu then advanced to Li Run Fort and divided troops to raid Linjin and Bayi.
translations.idiomatic: Wu advanced to Li Run Fort and sent columns to raid Linjin and Bayi.

sentences.zh: [3]將軍章直與戰，大敗之，兵溺死於河者三萬餘人。

translations.literal: [3] General Zhang Zhi fought him and greatly defeated him; more than thirty thousand soldiers drowned in the river.
translations.idiomatic: General Zhang Zhi fought him, [3] routed him, and more than thirty thousand drowned in the river.

sentences.zh: 吳又遣兵西掠至長安，將軍叔孫拔與戰於渭北，[4]大破之，斬首三萬餘級。

translations.literal: Wu again sent troops west to raid as far as Chang'an; General Shusun Ba fought him north of the Wei, [4] greatly defeated him, and beheaded more than thirty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Wu again sent troops toward Chang'an; Shusun Ba fought him north of the Wei, [4] routed him, and beheaded more than thirty thousand.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遼東王竇漏頭薨。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Prince of Liaodong Dou Loutou died.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day Dou Loutou, Prince of Liaodong, died.

sentences.zh: 河東蜀薛永宗聚黨盜官馬數千匹，驅三千餘人入汾曲，西通蓋吳，受其位號。

translations.literal: Shu of Hedong, Xue Yongzong, gathered a band, stole several thousand government horses, drove more than three thousand men into the Fen bend, and linked with Gai Wu in the west, receiving offices and titles from him.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Yongzong of Hedong Shu gathered a band, stole thousands of government horses, drove more than three thousand into the Fen bend, and joined Gai Wu in the west, taking rank from him.

sentences.zh: 秦州刺史、金城公周鹿觀率眾討之，不克而還。

translations.literal: Inspector of Qinzhou, Duke of Jincheng Zhou Luguan led troops against him but could not overcome him and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Luguan, Duke of Jincheng, Inspector of Qinzhou, attacked him but failed and returned.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔殿中尚書、扶風公元處真，尚書、平陽公慕容嵩二萬騎討薛永宗；

translations.literal: Day gengwu: an edict that Palace Attendant, Duke of Fufeng Yuan Chuzhen and Minister of Works, Duke of Pingyang Murong Song, with twenty thousand horse, were to campaign against Xue Yongzong;
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day he ordered Yuan Chuzhen, Duke of Fufeng, Palace Attendant, and Murong Song, Duke of Pingyang, Minister of Works, with twenty thousand horse against Xue Yongzong;

sentences.zh: 詔殿中尚書乙拔率五將三萬騎討蓋吳，西平公寇提三將一萬騎討吳黨白廣平。

translations.literal: an edict that Palace Attendant Yiba with five generals and thirty thousand horse was to campaign against Gai Wu; Duke of Xiping Kou Ti with three generals and ten thousand horse was to campaign against Wu's partisan Bai Guangping.
translations.idiomatic: he ordered Yiba, Palace Attendant, with five generals and thirty thousand horse against Gai Wu; and Kou Ti, Duke of Xiping, with three generals and ten thousand horse against Bai Guangping.

sentences.zh: 蓋吳自號天台王，署置百官。

translations.literal: Gai Wu styled himself King of Heavenly Terrace and appointed the hundred offices.
translations.idiomatic: Gai Wu styled himself King of Heavenly Terrace and set up the hundred offices.

sentences.zh: 辛未，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 選六州兵勇猛者二萬人，使永昌王仁、高涼王那分領，為二道，各一萬騎，南略淮泗以北，徙青徐之民以實河北。

translations.literal: Brave men from six provinces, twenty thousand in number, were selected; Prince of Yongchang Ren and Prince of Gaoliang Na were each to command one route of ten thousand horse and raid south of the Huai and Si, moving the people of Qing and Xu to fill Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty thousand brave men from six provinces were chosen; Ren, Prince of Yongchang, and Na, Prince of Gaoliang, each led ten thousand horse south of the Huai and Si and moved Qing and Xu people to fill Hebei.

sentences.zh: 癸未，車駕西巡。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the imperial carriage toured west.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day the emperor toured west.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月戊辰，車駕次東雍州。

translations.literal: Year 7, spring, first month, day wuchen: the imperial carriage halted at Eastern Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on the wuchen day of the first month of spring, the court halted at Eastern Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，圍薛永宗營壘。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Xue Yongzong's fortified camp was besieged.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Yongzong's camp was besieged.

sentences.zh: 永宗出戰，大敗，六軍乘之，永宗眾潰。

translations.literal: Yongzong came out to fight and was greatly defeated; the six armies pressed him and his host collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzong came out to fight, was routed, and the six armies overran his host.

sentences.zh: 永宗男女無少長赴汾水死。

translations.literal: Men and women of Yongzong's party, young and old alike, threw themselves into the Fen and died.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzong's people, young and old, threw themselves into the Fen and died.

sentences.zh: 辛未，車駕南幸汾陰。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the imperial carriage traveled south to Fenyin.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day the emperor went south to Fenyin.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，帝臨戲水。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the Emperor came to Xishui.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day the Emperor came to Xishui.

sentences.zh: 蓋吳退走北地。

translations.literal: Gai Wu withdrew to Beidi.
translations.idiomatic: Gai Wu withdrew to Beidi.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，幸長安，存問父老。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingxu: he came to Chang'an and inquired after the elders.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the bingxu day, he came to Chang'an and inquired after the elders.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，幸昆明池。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: he came to Kunming Pool.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day he came to Kunming Pool.

sentences.zh: 丙申，幸盩厔，誅叛民耿青、孫溫二壘與蓋吳通謀者。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: he came to Zhouzhi and executed the rebel people Geng Qing and Sun Wen at two forts for communicating with Gai Wu.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day he came to Zhouzhi and executed Geng Qing and Sun Wen at two forts for plotting with Gai Wu.

sentences.zh: 軍次陳倉，誅散關氐害守將者。

translations.literal: The army halted at Chencang and executed the Di of Sanguan who had harmed the garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: The army halted at Chencang and executed the Di of Sanguan who had killed the garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 還幸雍城，田於岐山之陽。

translations.literal: Returning, he came to Yong city and hunted on the south of Mount Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Returning, he came to Yong and hunted south of Mount Qi.

sentences.zh: 北道諸軍乙拔等大破蓋吳於杏城，吳棄馬遁走。

translations.literal: On the northern route Yiba and others greatly defeated Gai Wu at Xingcheng; Wu abandoned his horses and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Yiba and the northern army routed Gai Wu at Xingcheng; Wu abandoned his horses and fled.

sentences.zh: 永昌王仁至高平，擒劉義隆將王章，略金鄉、方與，遷其民五千家於河北。

translations.literal: Prince of Yongchang Ren reached Gaoping, captured Liu Yilong's general Wang Zhang, raided Jinxiang and Fangyu, and moved five thousand households to Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: Ren reached Gaoping, took Liu Yilong's general Wang Zhang, raided Jinxiang and Fangyu, and moved five thousand households to Hebei.

sentences.zh: 高涼王那至濟南東平陵，遷其民六千餘家於河北。

translations.literal: Prince of Gaoliang Na reached Dongpingling east of Jinan and moved more than six thousand households to Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: Na reached Dongpingling east of Jinan and moved more than six thousand households to Hebei.

sentences.zh: 三月，詔諸州坑沙門，毀諸佛像。

translations.literal: Third month: an edict that all provinces were to bury Buddhist monks alive and destroy all Buddha images.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he ordered all provinces to bury monks alive and destroy Buddha images.

sentences.zh: 徙長安城工巧二千家於京師。

translations.literal: Two thousand families of artisans of Chang'an were moved to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Two thousand artisan families of Chang'an were moved to the capital.

sentences.zh: 車駕旋軫，幸洛水，分軍誅李閏叛羌。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage turned back, came to the Luo River, and divided the army to execute the rebel Qiang of Li Run.
translations.idiomatic: The court turned back to the Luo and sent columns to execute the rebel Qiang of Li Run.

sentences.zh: 是月，金城邊冏、天水梁會反，據上邽東城。

translations.literal: That month Bian of Jincheng frontier and Liang Hui of Tianshui rebelled and held the eastern city of Shanggui.
translations.idiomatic: That month Bian of the Jincheng frontier and Liang Hui of Tianshui rebelled and held the eastern city of Shanggui.

sentences.zh: 秦州刺史封敕文擊之，斬冏，眾復推會為帥。

translations.literal: Inspector of Qinzhou Feng Jiwen attacked them, beheaded Bian, and the host again set up Hui as leader.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Jiwen attacked, beheaded Bian, and the host again made Hui leader.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，車駕至自長安。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiashen: the imperial carriage returned from Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiashen day, the court returned from Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 戊子，鄴城毀五層佛圖，於泥像中得玉璽二，其文皆曰「受命於天，既壽永昌」，其一刻其旁曰「魏所受漢傳國璽」。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: the five-story Buddha tower of Ye was destroyed; two jade seals were found in the clay images, both reading "Receiving the mandate from Heaven, long life and eternal stability," and one carved at the side: "The seal of Han transmitted to Wei."
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day Ye's five-story Buddha tower was torn down; two jade seals were found in the clay images reading "Receiving the mandate from Heaven, long life and eternal stability," one side carved "The seal Han transmitted to Wei."

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥，安豐公閭根率騎詣上邽，與敕文討梁會，會走漢中。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guihai: Duke of Anfeng Yan Gen led horse to Shanggui and with Jiwen campaigned against Liang Hui; Hui fled to Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the fifth month Yan Gen, Duke of Anfeng, led horse to Shanggui and with Jiwen attacked Liang Hui; Hui fled to Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 蓋吳復聚杏城，自號秦地王，假署山民，眾旅復振。

translations.literal: Gai Wu again gathered at Xingcheng, styled himself King of Qin and Earth, and by provisional appointment drew the mountain people; his host revived.
translations.idiomatic: Gai Wu again gathered at Xingcheng, styled himself King of Qin and Earth, appointed mountain people, and his host revived.

sentences.zh: 於是遣永昌王仁、高涼王那督北道諸軍同討之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Ren and Na were sent to command the armies of the northern route together against him.
translations.idiomatic: Ren and Na were sent to command the northern armies together against him.

sentences.zh: 六月甲申，發定、冀、相三州兵二萬人屯長安南山諸谷，以防越逸。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiashen: troops of Ding, Ji, and Xiang provinces, twenty thousand men, were mobilized to encamp in the valleys of the southern mountains of Chang'an to prevent escape.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the sixth month twenty thousand men of Ding, Ji, and Xiang were posted in the southern valleys of Chang'an to block escape.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，發司、幽、定、冀四州十萬人築畿上塞圍，起上谷，西至于河，廣袤皆千里。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: troops of Si, You, Ding, and Ji provinces, one hundred thousand men, were mobilized to build the encircling barrier of the capital frontier, from Shanggu west to the Yellow River, a thousand li in breadth and length alike.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day one hundred thousand men of Si, You, Ding, and Ji built the capital frontier barrier from Shanggu west to the Yellow River, a thousand li each way.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，蓋吳為其下人所殺，傳首京師。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month: Gai Wu was killed by his subordinates; his head was sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn Gai Wu was killed by his men; his head was sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 永昌王仁平其遺燼。

translations.literal: Prince of Yongchang Ren pacified his embers.
translations.idiomatic: Ren, Prince of Yongchang, pacified his embers.

sentences.zh: 高涼王那破蓋吳黨白廣平；

translations.literal: Prince of Gaoliang Na defeated Gai Wu's partisan Bai Guangping;
translations.idiomatic: Na defeated Bai Guangping, Gai Wu's partisan;

sentences.zh: 生擒屠各路那羅於安定，斬于京師。

translations.literal: Tuluona of Tulu Road was captured alive in Anding and beheaded in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Tuluona of Tulu Road was taken alive in Anding and beheaded in the capital.

sentences.zh: 復略陽公羯兒王爵。

translations.literal: Duke of Lueyang Jie'er's princely rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Jie'er, Duke of Lueyang, had his princely rank restored.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月，吐京胡阻險為盜。

translations.literal: Year 8, spring, first month: the Hu of Tujing blocked the passes and acted as bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, first month of spring, the Hu of Tujing blocked the passes and turned bandit.

sentences.zh: 詔征東將軍武昌王提、征南將軍淮南王他討之，不下。

translations.literal: An edict that General Who Conquers the East, Prince of Wuchang Ti, and General Who Conquers the South, Prince of Huainan Ta, were to campaign against them but could not overcome them.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Ti, Prince of Wuchang, General Who Conquers the East, and Ta, Prince of Huainan, General Who Conquers the South, against them but they could not take them.

sentences.zh: 山胡曹僕渾等渡河西，保山以自固，招引朔方諸胡。

translations.literal: The mountain Hu Cao Puhun and others crossed west of the river, held the mountains to secure themselves, and drew the various Hu of Shuofang.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Puhun and other mountain Hu crossed west of the river, held the mountains, and drew the Hu of Shuofang.

sentences.zh: 提等引軍討僕渾。

translations.literal: Ti and others led the army against Puhun.
translations.idiomatic: Ti and others led the army against Puhun.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，高涼王那等自安定討平朔方胡，因與提等合軍，共攻僕渾，斬之，其眾赴險死者以萬數。

translations.literal: Second month, day jimao: Na and others from Anding campaigned against and pacified the Shuofang Hu, then joined Ti and others to attack Puhun together, beheaded him, and those of his host who fled to the passes and died numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the second month Na from Anding pacified the Shuofang Hu, joined Ti, and together attacked Puhun, beheaded him, and tens of thousands died fleeing to the passes.

sentences.zh: 癸未，行幸中山，頒賜從官文武各有差。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the imperial carriage traveled to Zhongshan and distributed rewards to the accompanying civil and military officers, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day the emperor went to Zhongshan and rewarded the accompanying officers, each by rank.

sentences.zh: 高陽易縣民不從官命，討平之，徙其餘燼於北地。

translations.literal: The people of Yiyi in Gaoyang did not obey the government command; they were punished and pacified, and the remainder were moved to Beidi.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Yiyi in Gaoyang disobeyed; they were punished and pacified, and the remainder were moved to Beidi.

sentences.zh: 三月，河西王沮渠牧犍謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: Third month: Prince of Hexi Juqu Mujian plotted rebellion and was executed in secret.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Mujian, Prince of Hexi of the Juqu, plotted rebellion and was secretly executed.

sentences.zh: 徙定州丁零三千家於京師。

translations.literal: Three thousand Dingzhou Dingling households were moved to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand Dingling households of Dingzhou were moved to the capital.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 六月，西征諸將扶風公元處真等八將坐盜沒軍資，所在虜掠，贓各千萬計，並斬之。

translations.literal: Sixth month: the western campaign generals Yuan Chuzhen of Fufeng and eight other generals, for embezzling military supplies and plundering where they were posted, with booty each reckoned in the tens of millions, were all beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Yuan Chuzhen of Fufeng and eight western generals were beheaded for embezzling supplies and plundering, booty reckoned in tens of millions each.

sentences.zh: 八月，衞大將軍、樂安王範薨。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Grand General of the Guard, Prince of Le'an Fan, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Fan, Prince of Le'an, Grand General of the Guard, died.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月，劉義隆遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Year 9, spring, first month: Liu Yilong sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, first month of spring, Liu Yilong sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 氐楊文德受義隆官號，守葭蘆城，招誘武都、陰平五部氐民。

translations.literal: The Di Yang Wendé accepted office from Yilong, held Jialu Fort, and drew the Di of the five divisions of Wudu and Yinping.
translations.idiomatic: The Di Yang Wendé took rank from Yilong, held Jialu Fort, and drew the five Di divisions of Wudu and Yinping.

sentences.zh: 詔仇池鎮將皮豹子討之，文德棄城南走，擒其妻子僚屬。

translations.literal: An edict that the Chouchi garrison commander Pi Baozi was to campaign against him; Wendé abandoned the city and fled south; his wife, children, and staff were captured.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Pi Baozi, Chouchi garrison commander, against him; Wendé fled south and his family and staff were taken.

sentences.zh: 義隆白水太守郎啟玄率眾救文德，豹子逆擊，大破之，啟玄、文德走還漢中。

translations.literal: Yilong's Administrator of Baishui Lang Qixuan led a host to rescue Wendé; Baozi met and greatly defeated him; Qixuan and Wendé fled back to Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Lang Qixuan, Yilong's Administrator of Baishui, came to rescue Wendé; Baozi met and routed him; Qixuan and Wendé fled to Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 宕昌羌酋梁瑾慈遣使內附，并貢方物。

translations.literal: The Qiang chieftain of Dangchang, Liang Jin'ci, sent envoys to submit inward and also presented local products.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Jin'ci, Qiang chieftain of Dangchang, sent envoys to submit with local tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，行幸定州。

translations.literal: Second month, day guimao: the imperial carriage traveled to Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the guimao day, the emperor went to Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 山東民飢，啟倉賑之。

translations.literal: The people east of the mountains suffered famine; granaries were opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: The people east of the mountains suffered famine; storehouses were opened.

sentences.zh: 罷塞圍作。

translations.literal: Work on the frontier encirclement was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Work on the frontier barrier was halted.

sentences.zh: 遂西幸上黨，誅潞叛民二千餘家，徙西河離石民五千餘家于京師。

translations.literal: He then traveled west to Shangdang, executed more than two thousand rebel households of Lu, and moved more than five thousand households of Lishi in Xihe to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He went west to Shangdang, executed more than two thousand rebel households of Lu, and moved more than five thousand Lishi households of Xihe to the capital.

sentences.zh: 詔於壺關東北大王山累石為三封，又斬其北鳳皇山南足以斷之。

translations.literal: An edict piled stone as three mounds on Great King Mountain northeast of Huguan and also cut away the northern foot of Phoenix Mountain to sever it.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered stone piled as three mounds on Great King Mountain northeast of Huguan and the northern foot of Phoenix Mountain cut away.

sentences.zh: 三月，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Third month: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 夏五月甲戌，以交趾公韓拔為假節、征西將軍、領護西戎校尉、鄯善王，鎮鄯善，賦役其民，比之郡縣。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day jiaxu: Duke of Jiaozhi Han Ba was made Acting Commander, General Who Conquers the West, Colonel Protector of the Western Rong, and King of Shanshan, garrisoning Shanshan and levying corvée on its people like a commandery or district.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on the jiaxu day, Han Ba, Duke of Jiaozhi, was made Acting Commander, General Who Conquers the West, Colonel Protector of the Western Rong, and King of Shanshan, garrisoning Shanshan and levying its people like a district.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，行幸廣德宮。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinyou: the imperial carriage traveled to Broad Virtue Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the sixth month the emperor went to Broad Virtue Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，悅般國遣使求與王師俱討蠕蠕，帝許之。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the state of Yueban sent envoys asking to campaign against the Rouran together with the royal army; the Emperor granted it.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day Yueban asked to campaign against the Rouran with the royal army; the Emperor granted it.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，詔中外諸軍戒嚴。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month: an edict that all armies at court and in the provinces were to stand in readiness.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn he ordered all armies to stand ready.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，治兵于西郊。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yiyou: troops were arrayed at the western suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the ninth month troops were arrayed at the western suburb.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上幸陰山。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the Emperor came to Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day the Emperor came to Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 是月，成周公萬度歸千里驛上，大破焉耆國，其王鳩尸卑那奔龜茲。

translations.literal: That month Duke of Chenggong Wandu Gui came a thousand li by post-horse relay and greatly defeated the state of Yanqi; its king Jushibina fled to Kucha.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wandu Gui came a thousand li by relay and routed Yanqi; King Jushibina fled to Kucha.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛丑，恒農王奚斤薨。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinchou: Prince of Hengnong Xi Jin died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinchou day, Xi Jin, Prince of Hengnong, died.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以婚姻奢靡，喪葬過度，詔有司更為科限。

translations.literal: Day guimao: because marriage was extravagant and funerals excessive, an edict ordered the officials to set new regulations and limits.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, because marriage was extravagant and funerals excessive, he ordered new limits set.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Day guihai: a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day there was a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 十有二月，詔成周公萬度歸自焉耆西討龜茲。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: an edict that Duke of Chenggong Wandu Gui was to campaign west from Yanqi against Kucha.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he ordered Wandu Gui to campaign west from Yanqi against Kucha.

sentences.zh: 皇太子朝于行宮，遂從北討，至于受降城，不見蠕蠕，因積糧城內，留守而還。

translations.literal: The Crown Prince attended court at the traveling palace, then followed the northern campaign to Shouxiang Fort; no Rouran were seen, so grain was stored in the fort and a garrison left while the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: The Crown Prince attended at the traveling palace, followed the northern campaign to Shouxiang Fort, saw no Rouran, stored grain, left a garrison, and returned.

sentences.zh: 北平王長孫敦坐事降爵為公。

translations.literal: Prince of Beiping Changsun Dun was reduced to duke for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: Changsun Dun, Prince of Beiping, was reduced to duke for an offense.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月戊辰朔，帝在漠南，大饗百僚，班賜有差。

translations.literal: Year 10, spring, first month, day wuchen, first day: the Emperor was in the southern desert and feasted the hundred officials, distributing rewards each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, on the new-year wuchen day, the Emperor was in the southern desert, feasted the hundred officials, and rewarded each by rank.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，北伐。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day the northern campaign began.

sentences.zh: 二月，蠕蠕渠帥尒綿他拔等率其部落千餘家來降，蠕蠕吐賀真恐懼遠遁。

translations.literal: Second month: Rouran chieftains Ermitaba and others led more than a thousand households of their tribe to submit; Rouran Tuhezhen fled in fear to a distance.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Rouran chiefs Ermitaba and others led more than a thousand households to submit; Tuhezhen of the Rouran fled far in fear.

sentences.zh: 事具蠕蠕傳。

translations.literal: The account is fully set forth in the Rouran treatise.
translations.idiomatic: The full account is in the treatise on the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 三月，遂蒐于河西。

translations.literal: Third month: a hunt was then held in Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month a hunt was held in Hexi.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 夏五月庚寅，行幸陰山。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day gengyin: the imperial carriage traveled to Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on the gengyin day, the emperor went to Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，浮圖沙國遣使貢獻。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: the state of Futusha sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn the state of Futusha sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月，閱武磧上，遂北伐。

translations.literal: Ninth month: arms were reviewed on the desert; then the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month arms were reviewed on the desert, then the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 事具蠕蠕傳。

translations.literal: The account is fully set forth in the Rouran treatise.
translations.idiomatic: The full account is in the treatise on the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚子，皇太子及羣官奉迎於行宮。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengzi: the Crown Prince and the host of officials welcomed the Emperor at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the gengzi day, the Crown Prince and officials welcomed the Emperor at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 壬午，大饗，班賜所獲及布帛各有差。

translations.literal: Day renwu: a great feast; booty and cloth and silk were distributed, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day there was a great feast; booty and cloth were distributed by rank.

sentences.zh: 十有一月，龜茲、疏勒、破洛那、員闊諸國各遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: Kucha, Shule, Boluona, and Yuankuo states each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Kucha, Shule, Boluona, and Yuankuo each sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十有二月戊申，車駕至自北伐。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wushen: the imperial carriage returned from the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the wushen day, the court returned from the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以平昌公元託真為中山王。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Duke of Pingchang Yuan Tuozhen was made Prince of Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day Tuozhen, Duke of Pingchang, was made Prince of Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月乙酉，行幸洛陽，所過郡國，皆親對高年，存恤孤寡。

translations.literal: Year 11, spring, first month, day yiyou: the imperial carriage traveled to Luoyang; in every commandery and state passed through he personally addressed the aged and comforted orphans and the solitary.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, on the yiyou day of the first month of spring, the emperor went to Luoyang; in every district passed through he addressed the aged and comforted orphans.

sentences.zh: 以高涼王那為儀同三司。

translations.literal: Na, Prince of Gaoliang, was made Equal in Rank to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: Na, Prince of Gaoliang, was made Equal in Rank to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午，大蒐於梁川。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiawu: a great hunt was held at Liangchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiawu day, a great hunt was held at Liangchuan.

sentences.zh: 皇子真薨。

translations.literal: Prince Zhen died.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zhen died.

sentences.zh: 是月，大治宮室，皇太子居于北宮。

translations.literal: That month palaces were greatly repaired; the Crown Prince dwelt in the Northern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: That month palaces were greatly repaired; the Crown Prince dwelt in the Northern Palace.

sentences.zh: 車駕遂征懸瓠，益遣使者安慰境外之民，其不服者誅之。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage then campaigned against Xuanchi; envoys were further sent to comfort the people beyond the borders, and those who would not submit were executed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then marched on Xuanchi; envoys comforted border peoples and the disobedient were killed.

sentences.zh: 永昌王仁大破劉義隆將劉坦之、程天祚於汝東，斬坦之，擒天祚。

translations.literal: Prince of Yongchang Ren greatly defeated Liu Yilong's generals Liu Tanzhi and Cheng Tianzuo east of the Ru, beheaded Tanzhi, and captured Tianzuo.
translations.idiomatic: Ren routed Liu Tanzhi and Cheng Tianzuo east of the Ru, beheaded Tanzhi, and captured Tianzuo.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯，輿駕還宮，賜從者及留臺郎吏已上生口各有差。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guimao: the imperial carriage returned to the palace; followers and capital clerks of lang rank and above were given captives each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the guimao day, the court returned; followers and capital clerks of lang rank and above received captives by rank.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，誅司徒崔浩。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jihai: Chancellor of State Cui Hao was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the sixth month Cui Hao, Chancellor of State, was executed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，北巡陰山。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: a northern tour of Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day he toured Yinshan north.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，義隆遣其輔國將軍蕭斌之率眾六萬寇濟州，刺史王買得棄州走，斌之遂入城，仍使寧朔將軍王玄謨西攻滑臺。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: Yilong sent his General Who Assists the State Xiao Binzhi with sixty thousand men against Jizhou; Inspector Wang Maidé abandoned the province and fled; Binzhi entered the city and sent General Who Pacifies the North Wang Xuanno west against Huatai.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn Yilong sent Xiao Binzhi, General Who Assists the State, with sixty thousand against Jizhou; Inspector Wang Maidé fled; Binzhi took the city and sent Wang Xuanno, General Who Pacifies the North, west against Huatai.

sentences.zh: 詔枋頭鎮將、平南將軍、南康公杜道 助守兗州。

translations.literal: An edict that the Fangtou garrison commander, General Who Pacifies the South, Duke of Nankang Du Daojun was to assist in holding Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Du Daojun, Duke of Nankang, Fangtou garrison commander and General Who Pacifies the South, to assist in holding Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，田於河西。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guihai: a hunt was held in Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the guihai day, a hunt was held in Hexi.

sentences.zh: 癸未，治兵於西郊。

translations.literal: Day guimao: troops were arrayed at the western suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day troops were arrayed at the western suburb.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，輿駕南伐。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinmao: the imperial carriage campaigned south.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the ninth month the emperor marched south.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，皇太子北伐，屯于漠南，吳王余留守京都。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the Crown Prince campaigned north and encamped in the southern desert; Prince of Wu Yu remained to guard the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day the Crown Prince marched north to the southern desert; Yu, Prince of Wu, guarded the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚子，曲赦定冀相三州死罪已下。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: a partial amnesty for Ding, Ji, and Xiang provinces from death down.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day there was a partial amnesty in Ding, Ji, and Xiang from death downward.

sentences.zh: 發州郡兵五萬分給諸軍。

translations.literal: Fifty thousand troops of provinces and commanderies were distributed to the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty thousand provincial troops were assigned to the armies.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，車駕止枋頭。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guihai: the imperial carriage halted at Fangtou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the guihai day, the court halted at Fangtou.

sentences.zh: 詔殿中尚書長孫真率騎五千自石濟渡，備玄謨遁走。

translations.literal: An edict that Palace Attendant Changsun Zhen with five thousand horse was to cross from Shiji Ford to block Xuanno's escape.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Changsun Zhen, Palace Attendant, with five thousand horse to cross at Shiji Ford to block Xuanno.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，車駕濟河，玄謨大懼，棄軍而走，眾各潰散，追躡斬首萬餘級，器械山積。

translations.literal: Day yichou: the imperial carriage crossed the river; Xuanno was greatly afraid, abandoned the army and fled, and each host scattered; pursuit trampled and beheaded more than ten thousand; weapons piled like hills.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day the emperor crossed the river; Xuanno fled in terror, the hosts scattered, pursuit killed more than ten thousand, and weapons piled like hills.

sentences.zh: 帝遂至東平。

translations.literal: The Emperor then reached Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor then reached Dongping.

sentences.zh: 蕭斌之棄濟州，退保歷城。

translations.literal: Xiao Binzhi abandoned Jizhou and withdrew to defend Licheng.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Binzhi abandoned Jizhou and withdrew to Licheng.

sentences.zh: 乃命諸將分道並進：使征西大將軍永昌王仁自洛陽出壽春，尚書長孫真趨馬頭，楚王建趨鍾離，高涼王那自青州趨下邳。

translations.literal: The generals were then ordered to advance by separate routes: General Who Conquers the West Prince of Yongchang Ren from Luoyang toward Shouchun; Minister of Works Changsun Zhen toward Matou; Prince of Chu Jian toward Zhongli; Prince of Gaoliang Na from Qingzhou toward Xiapi.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered separate advances: Ren from Luoyang on Shouchun; Changsun Zhen on Matou; Jian, Prince of Chu, on Zhongli; Na from Qingzhou on Xiapi.

sentences.zh: 車駕自中道，[5]十有一月辛卯，至于鄒山，劉義隆魯郡太守崔邪利率屬城降。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage by the central route, [5] eleventh month, day xinmao: reached Mount Zou; Liu Yilong's Administrator of Lu commandery Cui Xielü led dependent cities to submit.
translations.idiomatic: By the central route, [5] in the eleventh month on the xinmao day he reached Mount Zou; Cui Xielü, Liu Yilong's Administrator of Lu, led dependent cities to submit.

sentences.zh: 使使者以太牢祀孔子。

translations.literal: An envoy was sent with the great offering to sacrifice to Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: An envoy sacrificed to Confucius with the great offering.

sentences.zh: 壬子，次于彭城，遂趨盱眙。

translations.literal: Day renzi: he halted at Pengcheng, then pressed toward Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day he halted at Pengcheng, then pressed toward Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 頞盾國獻師子一。

translations.literal: The state of Yandun presented one lion.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Yandun presented a lion.

sentences.zh: 十有二月丁卯，車駕至淮。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingmao: the imperial carriage reached the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dingmao day, the court reached the Huai.

sentences.zh: 詔刈雚葦，汎筏數萬而濟。

translations.literal: An edict to cut reed and rush; tens of thousands of rafts were launched to cross.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered reeds cut; tens of thousands of rafts crossed the river.

sentences.zh: 義隆盱眙守將臧質閉門拒守。

translations.literal: Yilong's defending general of Xuyi, Zang Zhi, shut the gates and held firm.
translations.idiomatic: Zang Zhi, Yilong's defender of Xuyi, shut the gates and held.

sentences.zh: 將軍胡崇之等率眾二萬援盱眙。

translations.literal: General Hu Chongzhi and others led twenty thousand men to relieve Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Chongzhi and others led twenty thousand to relieve Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 燕王譚大破之，梟崇之等，斬首萬餘級，淮南皆降。
